newsitem.title: NORWAY: Statoil stops oil output at Heidrun.
newsitem.headline: Statoil stops oil output at Heidrun.

text.p: Den norske stats oljeselskap AS (Statoil ) said on Thursday it had shut in oil production at the 250,000 barrels per day Heidrun field due to a technical snag.
Output was shut in at 0800 GMT on Wednesday after the flare tip disappeared from the platform, Statoil spokesman Odd Jan Lange told Reuters.
"We will inspect the flare system today. We don't know exactly how long it will take before we can restart production," Lange said.
The flare tip, a safety measure for releasing pressure in the processing facilities, fell off the Heidrun installation and was picked up by a ship late on Wednesday.
Latest figures from Statoil showed that Heidrun produced 249,738 barrels of crude on Tuesday.
